confidence: high on the fact, medium on blast radius
label: GENERATED_SKILL_COPY_RE was narrowed at v4.0.0.11 from the semicolon marker to the comma marker, so the semicolon spelling that the recorded mirrors actually carry (e.g. '<!-- generated by sync-skills-hermes.cjs; do not edit -->' under specs/system-skill-advisor/027-.../containment/quarantine) no longer matches the shipped pattern; those mirrors sit under containment/, which is_unscanned_record_path does not exempt (only evidence, scratch, z_archive, fixture), so the marker regex is the only thing keeping them out of the dead-route check. Verify: git show v4.0.0.11:.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-opencode/assets/scripts/verify_alignment_drift.py | sed -n '113p' and the inline python regex test returns False.

v4.0.0.11's note is titled 'Prove Your Git Setup in One Command' and its Upgrade section names only /doctor:git setup, while the same tag carries the sk-doc four-file bump 2.3.9.0 to 2.3.10.0, the sk-prompt bump 3.0.3.0 to 3.0.4.0, a new sk-code-opencode changelog v1.2.6.0, a /prompt:improve section reorder and the drift-guard regex change; none appear in the note. Verify: git diff --stat v4.0.0.4..v4.0.0.11 over the four hub trees plus .skilled/commands, compared against the note headings.

confidence: high on the heading order, medium on which canon clause owns it
label: The v4.0.0.11 window moved '## 1. ROUTER CONTRACT' below the input gate in /prompt:improve, so the document's first heading is now the level-3 '### MANDATORY INPUT GATE' with no level-2 parent, and section 1 no longer holds the first content. Verify: grep -n '^#\{1,3\} ' .skilled/commands/prompt/improve.md | head -4.

Two differently-worded skip policies now govern the same archive trees: is_unscanned_record_path (directory names, four classes claimed in the v4.0.0.12 docstring) applied at two call sites only, and GENERATED_SKILL_COPY_RE (marker string). Nothing breaks if the marker regex is removed because no live .hermes mirror exists and the emitter is absent from the tree; removing the record helper restores the 278-warning count the v4.0.0.12 note reports. Verify: grep -c is_unscanned_record_path returns 3 and ls .hermes reports no such file.

confidence: high on facts, medium on intent
label: sk-prompt is audited as a fourth peer hub but ships none of the hub metadata trio: hub-router.json, mode-registry.json and description.json are all absent, while sk-doc (2.9.7.0), sk-code (3.11.4.0) and sk-design (3.0.2.0) each agree across all four files. sk-prompt's version 4.0.4.0 lives only in SKILL.md frontmatter despite a 17,017-byte prose ROUTER.md, so any tool that reads the registry trio treats it as a leaf. Verify: node -e require('./.skilled/skills/sk-prompt/hub-router.json') throws.

confidence: high on exit codes, unknown on intent
label: On one stored report check-review-final-line.js exits 1 with 'FAIL: final line is not an exact status line' while check-review-findings.js exits 0 silently, with no 'no ## Findings heading, nothing to check' line, so a run that pipes both checkers cannot tell whether the findings shape holds or was never exercised. Verify: node .skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-review/scripts/check-review-final-line.js <report>; echo $? read directly without a pipe.

Each sk-design checker suite carries a completeness test asserting that every mutation family the checker registers has a case or a stated reason it cannot, so a family cannot be dropped silently; both suites pass (chart 88/88, diagram 21/21).
sk-design bug hunt found no bug: node --test scripts/tests/ in sk-design-chart passed 88/88 in 21,116 ms and in sk-design-diagram 21/21 in 22,414 ms.

Mandatory pre-selection load measured: sk-code 53,939 B (759 lines), sk-doc 49,797 B (674), sk-prompt 33,408 B (642), sk-design 18,205 B (328) counting SKILL.md plus ROUTER.md, a threefold spread across peers.

v4.0.0.16's legacy-location refusal is not circular in practice: the repair text points at 'the path the message names' and the thrown message supplies it via repoConfigTarget(root) at both the trust and discovery throw sites, and the quality config is at the documented skill-folder path.

direction: A sk-design chart or diagram correctness bug reachable through the packets' own test suites
reason: Both suites run green (88/88 and 21/21) and both enforce family completeness, so the assigned bug hunt produced no defect; further effort should go to the checker predicates themselves, not the suites.

direction: A live generated-skill-mirror regression at the repository root
reason: There is no .hermes directory at the root and sync-skills-hermes.cjs is absent from the tree, so F1's impact is confined to archived mirrors under specs/**/containment/**.
